name: After § 2
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the enforcement of the Digital Markets Act
part_text: 2b. Encourages the Commission to engage proactively with its regulatory counterparts in allied jurisdictions to foster international alignment in the enforcement of ex ante rules for digital markets and to regularly assess whether the DMA in fact constitutes the smallest possible and most effective intervention in the market; considers that such coordination would reduce the risk of conflicting obligations for businesses and strengthen the credibility and legitimacy of the DMA framework;
